The '''Third Pius Dea Crusade''' was a religious crusade orchestrated by the [[Pius Dea]] cult against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]]. The Pius Dea-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched an invasion of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] in [[11,939 BBY]].<ref name="EGW" />

Under the direction of the Pius Dea, the forces of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] began to attack the southern ends of Hutt Space. Launching their forces from the edge of Republic space, one fleet moved from [[Ord Gustald]] to [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]] and then [[Chalacta/Legends|Chalacta]], while an additional two fleets were launched from [[Ord Thabl]] against [[Cyborrea/Legends|Cyborrea]] and the northern region of Hutt Space. A fourth fleet jumped from the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|Ootmian Pabol]] trade route to [[Nimban/Legends|Nimban]], just on the edge of Hutt Space. The Third Crusade would be followed nineteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later in [[11,920 BBY]] by a [[Fourth Pius Dea Crusade|fourth crusade]] against the Hutts, continuing a trend of religious persecution of aliens.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Third Pius Dea Crusade was first referenced in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. While not mentioned explicitly in the text, the Third Crusade appears on a map of the Crusades and their movement across the galaxy.<ref name="EGW" />
